note: SCR-01G (Keen 6): Paddle War from the title as the intro ends (Escape at 33 s: a key that cuts the intro short opens the panel at once in the user's v1.0 and shows the title first in v1.4, which the port plays, J-19), Keen's paddle left alone for half a minute: the computer's score counts into two figures. The whole game to 21 and its You lost! box are Keen 4's and 5's scr_paddle (the same code). Menu keys 1.75 s apart, between two blinks of the cursor. Times are seconds after the EGA mode set (KEYFEED.COM types the keys in DOS).
